title: KB3k certificate: the mu2-constant even-half condition for the 18-point cover question of F2^7
summary: The mu2-constant lead of PR 3108 is DEMOTED as a proof filter. mu2 = |A+A| + |B+B| - |G| is an exact identity for every reduced cover; mu2 is constant per split only when the selfsum-size sum |A+A| + |B+B| is, and that sum is NOT pinned by the covering condition: it varies at the minimal split (4,4) in F2^3. For the both-odd target regime (11,7)/(9,9), mu2 is constant at every scale where covers exist but is CHECKED, not forced. No class is decided; no cover constructed; no false kill.

claims.label: PROVEN
claims.statement: For every reduced covering pair (A,B) of G=F2^m (A+B=G and (A+A) u (B+B)=G), mu2 = |(A+A) n (B+B)| = |A+A| + |B+B| - |G|, and (A+A) u (B+B) = G.
claims.evidence: Inclusion-exclusion on (A+A) u (B+B) = G: |A+A| + |B+B| = |G| + mu2. Validated exhaustively at 0 violations over all 41,341 F2^3 covers and all F2^4 covers enumerated (mu2_search.py identity, verify.py quick).

claims.label: PROVEN
claims.statement: mu2 is not constant per split. The minimal variation split is (4,4) in F2^3 (3,360 covers): mu2 = 6 when both halves are generic (|A+A|=|B+B|=7), mu2 = 3 when exactly one half is an affine plane (|A+A|=4 or |B+B|=4). mu2 = 6 - 3*(number of plane halves).
claims.evidence: Complete enumeration of F2^1 (2 elements), F2^2 (4), F2^3 (8): no mu2 variation at F2^1 or F2^2; first variation at F2^3 at split (4,4). mu2_mechanism.py, verify.py quick (minimal varying split assertion).

claims.label: PROVEN
claims.statement: mu2 varies with the additive structure of a half. In F2^3 a 4-set is either a coset of a 2-dim subspace (affine plane, |A+A|=4) or generic (|A+A|=7). A structured half lowers |A+A| by 3 and mu2 by 3. At (4,6) in F2^4 the split is constant (mu2=4) only because the two selfsum sizes are anti-correlated by the cover condition (|A+A|=4 forces |B+B|=16; |A+A|=7 forces |B+B|=13; sum 20).
claims.evidence: mu2_mechanism.py (4,4) cluster table; mu2_search.py m4 (4,6) sa_set=[4,7], sb_set=[13,16], sum_set=[20], mu2=4 all 143,360 covers.

claims.label: CHECKED
claims.statement: For the both-odd target regime (11,7)/(9,9), mu2 is constant at every both-odd split where covers can be produced, but this is not forced. F2^3 both-odd splits all constant (complete). F2^5 (7,7) 310 covers, all mu2=12 with |A+A|=|B+B|=22. F2^6 (9,9)/(11,7) covers were not produced in a bounded hill-climbing search (0 in 300 restarts each), so mu2 variation at the exact target splits is neither observed nor ruled out.
claims.evidence: mu2_search.py m3 (both-odd complete); mu2_odd_search.py (F2^5 (7,7) 310 covers mu2=12; F2^6 (9,9)/(11,7) 0 covers); mu2_search.py m5odd/m6 sampling. The (4,4) counterexample shows the covering condition does not pin mu2 in general.

claims.label: DEMOTED
claims.statement: The plan 'mu2 is constant per split, carry it to PR 2911's 501/196 rows as a filter, then lift to m=6' is not justified. mu2-constancy is scale- and split-dependent: false for both-even splits ((4,4) F2^3), empirical for both-odd splits, unforced everywhere. It cannot be applied as a hard proof filter without a both-odd forcing proof (absent). This is the same shape as PR 3034's demoted scale-dependent self-sum lift.
claims.evidence: PROVEN minimal variation at (4,4) F2^3 (NOT_FORCED_MINIMAL); CHECKED both-odd constancy only (BOTH_ODD_CONSTANT_NOT_FORCED). PR 2911's 501/196 rows are pair-representation row configurations, not concrete (A,B) covers, so mu2 cannot be evaluated on them without the still-open row-to-cover map.

claims.label: CHECKED
claims.statement: The (12,6) A-vanish (4,2) decision walk is continued as a budget-honest partial (never an exclusion). PR 3108's sharded walk is extended by shard 29 with a per-shard receipt (explicit complete/budget_hit flags, budget checked after every U), and re-run from empty receipts with identical counters to prove recomputation.
claims.evidence: run42.py/walk42.py (vendored byte-exact from PR 3108) drive the walk; AV42-AV42-29.json is this session's clean from-empty shard receipt; AV42-RECOMPUTE-29-first-run.json is the preserved first clean run compared against the re-run from empty (counters identical). Aggregate over all complete shards in CERTIFICATE numbers.

claims.statement: Recorded anchors reproduced before any new number.
claims.evidence: PR 3108 verify.py quick (vendored): PR 2870 OBSTRUCTION parseval=696 allowed=504 deficit=192 (live); PR 2933 CLASSIFY tight=2 cases=6720 (live); PR 2961 FOURIER (7,1) need=175 lower=239 contradiction=True (live); PR 2961 CLASS82 checked=28,815,360 covering=0, CLASS60 d_checked=169,911, PR 3023 AV51 uv_pairs=3,049,492,320 covering=0 (read back from PR 3023's pinned receipts); PR 3108 SELFSUM (5,5)=3,136/(7,7)=64 profiles (8,8,8), CENSUS33 (3,3) covers=296,352 (read back).

The (4,2) walk partial covers a fraction of the normalized pairs and is not an exclusion. Word-level state (PR 2973/3005, Nicholas Stone / Nick Petalas) records 22 <= f(7) <= 24 and is untouched (SET-level only here).
